description: THE SHAPE->MECHANISM INDEX (the missing link the rule-indexing build cc98b4eb diagnosed). categorise_by_shape RECOGNIZES a concern's meta-shape and grow_part_library holds mechanisms, but the two were DISCONNECTED: on recognizing 'this is selective_gating', nothing retrieved the held selective_gating MECHANISM (spatial foveation) to TRANSFER into the new domain. Each Mechanism node here indexes ONE held cross-domain mechanism BY its meta_shape, carrying its abstract slot-roles (FIELD/UNIT/FOCUS style, each with a cue that anchors the target-domain filler in a goal's own structure) and its plan STEPS templated over those roles. retrieve_and_transfer_mechanism reads this index on a recognized shape and re-instantiates the mechanism's steps with the GOAL's fillers (space->rules, quanta->event-type, focus->focus) -- real analogical transfer, not a lookup: the output plan is the goal domain's, structurally isomorphic to the source. The slot binding is DERIVED from the goal's own predicate/argument structure via the cues; the mechanism holds the ABSTRACT procedure, never the target fillers.
